decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several variants that is tightly aligned with the firm's stated direction and core salami capabilities, it remains a low-cost option worth keeping open and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
This new organic Fleischwurst extends the established core assortment in a familiar format, so uncertainty is still resolving and the cost of keeping it on the market for further learning is modest.

The organic thinly sliced chicken breast line fits the expansion into organic variants, has several models, and merits more time because it builds on existing slicing and premium cold-cut know-how at relatively low continuation cost.

The organic herb-coated salami is close to the firm's core offer but appears more niche than the flagship lines, so it should be kept for now as an option while demand becomes clearer, though its withdrawal risk is somewhat higher.
